candidate_reviews.reason: S05 explicitly describes an executable global FIFO and AC-D05 queues two confirmed games. Permanently having no executor for otherwise runnable B after successful A defeats that behavior; no numeric latency SLA is inferred.

candidate_reviews.reason: Two nonterminal records for one game and cancellation lost to a stale Upsert violate uniqueness/user intent even with serial connections. Separate roots and serialized installation do not prove two executors writing the same file.

candidate_reviews.excluded_variant_reason: Detail UI still projects failed as the existing task and download card retries that same task. Enqueue's failed exclusion alone lacks a normal reachable duplicate sequence.

candidate_reviews.reason: Time plus task-ID ordering is explicit; ORDER BY created lacks the tie-break. Waiting cards must explain effective queue order. Newest-first history alone is not forbidden, but no effective position/order is displayed.
required_limits: No data-loss or concurrency impact is established.
Do not state that every newest-first history layout is noncompliant; effective queue position can satisfy the specification.

unpromoted_observations.reason: Rule requires lease/reconciliation but does not require a custom application table or file lock. WorkManager unique durable work/processor dedupe may supply equivalent ownership. Absence of a separate app lease is not sufficient proof of simultaneous production archive writers.
05-data-state requires failed ownership retention; a concrete reachable duplicate command sequence still has to be proved.
